info.leftShoulder: left arm raise: angle between upper arm and the line down her side (0 = arm hanging, 90 = straight out, 180 = straight up)
info.leftElbow: left elbow angle (180 = straight arm, 90 = bent at a right angle)
info.leftHip: left thigh raise from hanging straight down (0 = standing, 90 = knee up level with the hip)
info.leftWristHead: distance from left wrist to head / shoulder width
info.rightWristHead: distance from right wrist to head / shoulder width
info.leftWristHip: distance from left wrist to left hip / shoulder width
info.rightWristHip: distance from right wrist to right hip / shoulder width
info.leftWristUp: height of the left wrist above the head / shoulder width (+ = above the head)
info.leftHandUp: left hand height above the left shoulder / arm length (-1 = hanging straight down, 0 = level with the shoulder, +1 = straight up); body-proportion free, so it is what her self-check scores
info.torsoLean: how far the torso leans off vertical, degrees
info.torsoLeanSide: sideways lean, degrees (+ = toward her left)
info.headTilt: head tilt vs the shoulder line, degrees (+ = toward her left shoulder)
info.armSymmetry: left vs right arm match, 0..1 (1 = mirror-equal)
